name: plumbing_shared_seed
description: Seeding quirk of 6.2 [compat] [quirk], hand-derived: pump a (capacity 400, its own lot at (5,5)) and pump b (capacity 600, no lot of its own, anchored in a's lot) share the seed cell (5,5); the list is [b, a] (push_front). Pipes x = 5..9 at z = 5; a consumer of 300 at (12,5) (ring 3 from (9,5), watered). b seeds first; the flood finds the first producer in list order with seed (5,5), which is b (already visited), so a is never reached and seeds the same network again. Two seeds -> 2N + 7 = 11 calls. Each seed clears the bitmap, so the consumer is charged per seed: b's network supply 600, consumed 300 -> b used 300; a's supply 400, consumed 300 -> a used 300; last month consumed 300 + 300 = 600, produced 600 + 400 = 1000.
